articles.title: CJI had sought probe against HC judge. He is Jharkhand acting CJ now
articles.description: CJI Surya Kant asked M S Sonak to investigate multiple complaints regarding Justice Sujit Narayan Prasad's integrity. Many of these complaints were supported by documentary evidence, which adds credibility to the claims. Complaints against Justice Prasad also reached Chief Minister Hemant Soren, who urged CJI Kant to address these concerns. Justice Prasad has held his position since 2014 but could face scrutiny due to the complaints received.

articles.title: Bloodbath at Rohtak hotel: How 'girlfriend' lured gangster into murder trap; 4 shot dead
articles.description: Jhanvi Chaudhary allegedly posed as Sunny Ritolia's girlfriend to facilitate a murder plot by the Himanshu Bhau gang. On November 25, she brought Sunny to the Milan hotel, where armed assailants opened fire, resulting in four deaths. The conspiracy to kill Sunny had been planned for months, with Jhanvi being given a flat and a car. After the shooting, she quickly fled to the Delhi airport and left for Bangkok.

A house renovation in London uncovered a basket hidden behind a wall
articles.description: In a fascinating archaeological find at Lauderdale House, London, a wicker basket dating back to the 17th century was unearthed, revealing hidden objects like broken shoes. These artifacts were once believed to safeguard homes from malevolent spirits. The discovery, which also included four chickens, sheds light on post-medieval England's unique customs aimed at protecting households from supernatural threats and tells a fascinating story of domestic life.

C$470 million payout for Nova Scotia workers after court strikes down wage restriction law
articles.description: Public sector workers in Canada's Nova Scotia province could receive up to C$5,000 each under a C$470 million compensation deal approved by a court. The settlement follows a ruling that declared a 2015 law restricting wage increases and long-service benefits unconstitutional. Around 81,000 workers may qualify for wage-related damages, while payments must be completed by December 31, 2027.

articles.title: Basil Joseph says Indian cinema’s hero image makes superhero films challenging
articles.description: Basil Joseph engaged in a thought-provoking discussion at IFFI Goa about the complexities of crafting superhero films within Indian cinema. He emphasized the prevalence of male heroes endowed with supernatural abilities, which presents unique challenges in developing original storylines. Reflecting on his experience with ‘Minnal Murali’, Joseph illustrated how creative restrictions can generate innovative concepts, proving that limitations can sometimes surpass dependence on visual effects.

articles.title: Vijay Sethupathi reacts to Tom Hanks' praise for 'Maharaja'
articles.description: Vijay Sethupathi was taken aback by Tom Hanks' reaction to his film 'Maharaja'. Hanks lauded the performance of Sachana Namidass, who portrays his daughter. A mutual friend, Kavita Gupta, introduced Hanks to the film, sparking this delightful recognition. Sethupathi expressed his deep admiration for Hanks and felt privileged by the praise. Released in 2024, 'Maharaja' garnered significant international acclaim.
